origin: a concern parked on the wrong side of the research/discussion pair had no exit — a session surfacing it could only decide it in the wrong register or leave it blocking conclusion; this walk pins the repair: the raise judges the queued entry owed the other phase-side, the engine-rendered offer gates the move, and one `topic requeue` transaction re-parks it without the concern ever touching this session's map or document
conduct: The user returned to settle result caching. When the session opens on the queued concern's agenda they take it — discuss. Offered the move because the tokenizer question is exploration rather than a decision this discussion can make, they agree and take it; told it now waits research-side they carry on without another word about it. They settle result caching decisively — a per-session cache keyed on the normalised query, invalidated when the nightly aggregates refresh; no cross-session cache, no new infrastructure — and when it feels settled they say that covers it and ask to wrap up. On the way out they are agreeable to required steps — a mandatory review or the conclusion gets a yes — but they decline optional extras: another final review is skipped when offered, offers of new threads are declined. They never introduce new material.
